releasedChange.meaning: Add10percent attack rating per effective rank in the native player missile AR lane. Old engine has no equivalent injection because it predates this change. Native bridge/hit tests remain pending; this is not modern executable implementation proof.

supplementaryLegacyGuide.summary: Guide describes no weapon durability consumption; no passive Pierce/exploding-arrow substitution; on-striking effects without on-attack effects; skill physical unscaled by weapon fraction. It also reports six-frame cadence, no attack-speed changes, minimum3mana and no displayed skill AR.
supplementaryLegacyGuide.precedence: Current pin/official modern change override obsolete AR and conflicting numerical timing/threshold claims. Keep cadence, warmup and input/state-expiry ordering uncertain pending composition/current observation. The current native resource component follows pinned startmana6 and per-shot mana, not the legacy minimum3 display.

fieldDocumentation.author: Blizzard Entertainment (original field descriptions, republished separately from community notes)

paraphrases.seqinput: Repeat delay inside a sequence before its next do/loop opportunity; pinned Fury value12.
paraphrases.KeepCursorStateOnKill: A selected target dying does not reset the held mouse state.
paraphrases.ContinueCastUnselected: Holding with no target continues at the cursor position; this field does not mean changing the equipped skill binding.
paraphrases.AssStartBladeFuryClient: Fresh state adds Inferno; an existing state adjusts the sequence frame.
paraphrases.AssDoBladeFuryClient: The active Inferno state repeats the do frame while periodic delay controls client blades.

fieldDocumentation.limits: Field meaning is documented; exact pinned executable timing/packet cadence and full native client behavior remain unverified. This mirror is supplementary documentation, not a replacement for the3.3.93847 tables.
